title: Simulation 3D Camera
text: Camera sensor model with lens in 3D simulation environment, 2 inputs, 5 outputs, {Mounting location} sets Sensor mounting location; {Sensor identifier} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Parent name} sets the name of parent vehicle, {Specify offset} sets the offset from mounting location, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the translation offset relative to mounting location, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the rotational offset relative to mounting location, {Sample time}, {Focal length (pixels)} sets the focal length of camera, {Optical center (pixels)} sets the optical center of camera, {Image size (pixels)} sets the image size produced by camera, {Radial distortion coefficients}, {Tangential distortion coefficients}, {Axis skew} sets the skew angle of camera axes, {Visualize field of view} sets the option to visualize camera field of view, {Field of view range (m)} sets the visualization range, {Output depth}, {Output semantic segmentation} and {Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} sets the output location and orientation of sensor. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Rel Translation
ports.summary: Relative translation of sensor from mounting point (m) [0 0 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector of form [ X Y Z ]

ports.name: Rel Rotation
ports.summary: Relative rotation of sensor from mounting point (deg) [0 0 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector of form [ Roll Pitch Yaw ]

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: 3D output camera image m -by- n -by-3 array of RGB triplet values

ports.name: Depth
ports.summary: Object depth from 0 m to 1000 m m -by- n array of object depths

ports.name: Labels
ports.summary: Label identifiers m -by- n array of label identifiers

params.name: Parent name
params.values: Name of parent vehicle Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: Translation offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Rotational offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Focal length (pixels)
params.values: Focal length of camera [1109, 1109] (default) | 1-by-2 positive integer vector

params.name: Optical center (pixels)
params.values: Optical center of camera [640, 360] (default) | 1-by-2 positive integer vector

params.name: Image size (pixels)
params.values: Image size produced by camera [720, 1280] (default) | 1-by-2 positive integer vector

params.name: Radial distortion coefficients
params.values: Radial distortion coefficients [0, 0] (default) | real-valued 2-element vector | real-valued 3-element vector | real-valued 6-element vector

params.name: Axis skew
params.values: Skew angle of camera axes 0 (default) | nonnegative real-valued scalar

params.name: Visualize field of view
params.values: Option to visualize camera field of view off (default) | on

params.name: Output semantic segmentation
params.values: Output semantic segmentation map of label IDs off (default) | on

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: Output location and orientation of sensor off (default) | on
